instruction: I find italic text difficult to read. Please change the font size of all italicized words to 15 points while keeping them italic.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing italic text size to 15pt. Verified document has 21 italic runs at size 12pt (152400 twips). Evaluator checks if all italic text is now size 15.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies all italic text by checking run.italic property
Evaluator correctly verifies font size is 15 points for all italic runs
Complete coverage: all italic text in the document is checked
Proper edge case handling: filters empty text with strip(), checks if font.size exists before accessing .pt
Appropriate all-or-nothing scoring: returns 1.0 only if ALL italic text is size 15, matching the instruction requirement 'all italicized words'
Postconfig properly saves document with Ctrl+S before verification
The get_vm_file getter can successfully retrieve and cache the DOCX file for evaluation
